أخروط (form XIII)
# أَخْرَوِّطُ (ʔaḵrawwiṭu) /ʔax.raw.wi.tˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْرَوَّطَ (iḵrawwaṭa)
# أَخْرَوِّطَ (ʔaḵrawwiṭa) /ʔax.raw.wi.tˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْرَوَّطَ (iḵrawwaṭa)
# أَخْرَوِّطْ (ʔaḵrawwiṭ) /ʔax.raw.witˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِخْرَوَّطَ (iḵrawwaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
